circuit.name: Buck Boost DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Inverting buck-boost (step-up/step-down) DC-DC converter. Input: 12V nominal. Duty cycle: 40%. Expected output: ~-8V (INVERTING, NEGATIVE output). Output voltage formula: V_out = -V_in * D/(1-D) = -12 * 0.4/0.6 = approx -8V (NEGATIVE). Topology: Single PMOS high-side switch, freewheeling diode, series inductor, output filter capacitor. Note: Output positive terminal (Cout+, R_LOAD+) connected to VIN-/ground.

requirements.requirement: Startup transient from 12V input to -12.0V output.
Steady-state operation. Verify output voltage regulation at -12.0V.

data.name: rise_time_10_90
data.spice_command: TRIG [VOUT] VAL={0.1*{criteria.target_vout}} FALL=1 TARG [VOUT] VAL={0.9*{criteria.target_vout}} FALL=1
